criteria.reason: Wear-and-tear rule explained accurately; deposit bank-account rule omitted.
No lawyer claim or guaranteed outcome.
Schlichtungsbehörde named correctly, But 'MIKA' agency appears invented.
Provides concrete steps and a full template letter.

factual_errors: 'MIKA – MieterInnen-Beratung Zürich' appears invented; the real body is Mieterverband Zürich (Mieterberatung).
summary: Gives useful steps and a letter but omits the deposit bank-account rule, never disclaims judging the specific case, and invents a tenant-advice agency.
